messages.subject: [rkward-users] proposal
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

On Wednesday 10 August 2011, Peppe wrote:
> I was thinking,  why notadd something like right click"run
> inbatchmode"for .R  files?

you mean in the file browser window? Yes, that sounds like it could be useful.

Could you add that suggestion to our feature request tracker 
(http://sourceforge.net/tracker/?atid=459010&group_id=50231&func=browse)? It 
often takes a while until we get around to implement new features, and having 
ideas listed in the tracker is the best way to make sure, we don't forget 
about them.

Regards
Thomas

messages.subject: [rkward-users] how to disable "large plot warning"
messages.body_plain:
Hi!

Sorry for the long delay.

On Friday 12 August 2011, Andrey Chetverikov wrote:
> How can I disable "Large plot! Do you still want to store it in the
> history?" warning?

You can configure the limit using "Settings->Configure RKWard->Onscreen 
Graphics->Maximum size of a single recorded plot".

Regards
Thomas
